record_rules.canonical_reference: A canonical role reference is current only when it is bound to the exact permanent-role authority graph digest.
record_rules.legacy_alias: A legacy alias normalizes before current validation and never grants authority by itself.
record_rules.accepted_history: Accepted history remains immutable; migration emits a new content-addressed reference receipt.
record_rules.incomplete_roster: A legacy two-role or expanded permanent-role roster is not a current five-role roster and must be explicitly rebound.
record_rules.ambiguous_record: Missing, conflicting, or lifecycle-duty evidence denies migration rather than guessing between Intent Regulator and Controller.
